Wsparcie przedsiębiorstw w przygotowaniu: Supporting businesses in structuring and managing investment and working-capital financing, as well as ongoing relationships with banks and other financing institutions.
Finansowanie, gwarancje bankowe i obsług: Financing, bank guarantees and debt management.
Analiza · Modele · Negocjacje · Zabezpie: Analysis · Modelling · Negotiations · Collateral · Guarantees · Drawdowns · Monitoring
Analiza obejmuje zapotrzebowanie na kapi: The analysis covers capital requirements arising from investment projects, day-to-day operations and the working-capital cycle. Potential sources, financing tenors and repayment schedules are assessed against the company's cash flows.
Wsparcie w doborze relacji kapitału włas: Support in determining an appropriate mix of equity and debt and preparing alternative financing structures.
Assessment of financing needs and alternative structures.
Modele obejmują projekcje wyników, bilan: Financial models cover projections of profit and loss, balance sheet and cash flows, assessment of debt-servicing capacity and the impact of changing assumptions on liquidity and financial ratios.
Przygotowanie obejmuje informacje i opra: Preparation includes the information and materials needed to present the company or investment project to prospective lenders.
Model finansowy, projekcje i analizy sce: Financial model, projections and scenario analyses.
Wsparcie obejmuje przygotowanie i koordy: Support covers preparing and coordinating the financing process: from defining its scope and timetable, through engaging selected institutions, to reviewing proposals and negotiating terms.
Uzupełnieniem jest pomoc w odpowiedziach: This also includes helping prepare responses to lenders' questions and organising the required data and documentation.
Pakiet informacji, harmonogram i porówna: Information package, process timetable and comparison of proposals.
Analiza i wsparcie negocjacji z bankami: Analysis and support in negotiations with banks cover pricing, tenors and repayment arrangements, drawdown conditions and covenants.
Wsparcie obejmuje przygotowanie i uzgodn: Support includes designing and negotiating a security package that meets lenders' requirements while taking account of the company's financial capacity and future funding needs.
Wsparcie w pozyskaniu gwarancji obejmuje: Support in obtaining bank guarantees includes selecting the appropriate type, preparing the application and agreeing the amount, term, wording and security with the bank. Ongoing support may cover amendments, extensions and release or expiry of guarantees.
Wsparcie uzgodnień z bankami uczestniczą: Support in coordinating participating banks covers shared terms, collateral arrangements and information undertakings. Documentation matters requiring legal advice are handled in conjunction with the company's legal advisers.
Analiza warunków kredytowych, propozycja: Analysis of loan terms, proposed security package and negotiation issues list.
Wsparcie w finansowaniu budowy, rozbudow: Support with financing construction, expansion and commencement of operations, including manufacturing facilities.
Punktem odniesienia dla struktury finans: The financing structure is assessed in relation to the capital expenditure budget, equity contribution, expenditure schedule and the ramp-up period to planned operating capacity.
Koordynacja obejmuje przygotowanie dokum: Coordination covers preparing documentation and fulfilling obligations relating to subsequent drawdowns and the administration of funding.
Harmonogram warunków, transz i rozliczeń: Schedule of conditions, drawdowns and settlements.
Monitorowanie zadłużenia i zmiany warunk: Debt monitoring and amendments to terms
Bieżąca obsługa obejmuje monitorowanie k: Ongoing support includes monitoring financial covenants, reporting obligations, repayment dates and other undertakings to lenders.
Wsparcie obejmuje przygotowanie raportów: Support covers preparing reports, updating forecasts and analysing variances. Where the company's circumstances or an investment project call for changes, discussions are prepared on credit terms, security, maturities or refinancing.
Kalendarz obowiązków, monitoring i waria: Compliance calendar, monitoring and amendment scenarios.
Planowana inwestycja, budowa lub uruchom: A planned investment, construction project or start-up of operations.
Rozmowy z bankami i porównanie propozycj: Discussions with banks and comparison of financing proposals.
Uruchamianie kolejnych transz i rozlicza: Drawdowns of successive tranches and investment settlements.
Zmiana warunków, zabezpieczeń lub termin: Changes to terms, collateral arrangements or repayment dates.
Refinansowanie i uporządkowanie istnieją: Refinancing and restructuring of existing debt arrangements.
Początek współpracy to określenie celu,: An engagement begins by establishing the objective, the company's position and the information required. The next step is to agree on tasks, a timetable and responsibilities.
Współpraca może dotyczyć konkretnego opr: An engagement may concern a specific deliverable, a selected stage of the financing process or ongoing support in managing financing and bank relationships.
